zh.title: 西捷航空波音737 MAX 8拖行時翼梢小翼撞上停放餐車、機上無人且無人受傷
zh.summary: 西捷航空一架波音737 MAX 8在多倫多皮爾遜機場拖行至過夜停機位時撞上停放餐車，機上無人、無人受傷，損傷程度尚未確認。
body: 一架西捷航空波音737 MAX 8在多倫多皮爾遜國際機場（YYZ）拖行至過夜停機位時，翼梢小翼撞上一輛停放的餐車。機上沒有乘客或機組人員，也沒有人受傷；飛機損傷程度尚未正式確認。加拿大運輸安全委員會表示，碰撞約在週二晚間8時15分發生，機場應急單位隨後啟動；該委員會正在蒐集相關資訊，但不打算派遣調查人員。
該機登記號碼為C-FRYV，約在碰撞前兩小時以WS2221航班自巴亞爾塔港飛抵多倫多。西捷航空向Simple Flying證實，飛機當時並非自行滑行，而是被拖行；最初社群影片附帶的說法稱飛機是在落地後滑行前往登機門，航空公司與主管機關已澄清並非如此。報導指出，這類地面處理碰撞並不罕見，近年已造成多家航空公司昂貴維修、航班取消與長時間停飛。
報導引述國際航空運輸協會2025年年度安全報告指出，地面損傷每年造成業界損失逾45億美元，若無進一步預防措施，15年內可能達到97億美元。對西捷航空而言，這架737 MAX 8的最終維修費用與停飛時間目前仍未知。

en.title: WestJet Boeing 737 MAX 8 winglet strikes parked catering truck while being towed in Toronto, with no one injured
en.summary: A WestJet Boeing 737 MAX 8 being towed to an overnight parking pad at Toronto Pearson struck a parked catering truck; no one was on board and no injuries were reported, and the damage has not been officially confirmed.
body: A WestJet Boeing 737 MAX 8 struck a parked catering truck with its winglet while being towed to an overnight parking pad at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ). No passengers or crew were on board and no injuries were reported, while the extent of the aircraft's damage has not been officially confirmed. Canada's Transportation Safety Board said the collision occurred at about 8:15 p.m. on Tuesday evening, airport emergency response units were activated shortly thereafter, and it was gathering information but did not plan to deploy investigators.

The aircraft, registered C-FRYV, had arrived at Toronto about two hours earlier operating as WS2221 from Puerto Vallarta. WestJet confirmed to Simple Flying that the aircraft was being towed, not taxiing under its own power after landing, contrary to initial claims accompanying footage circulating on social media. The report notes that such ground-handling collisions are not rare and have led in recent years to expensive repairs, canceled flights and prolonged groundings for numerous airlines.

Citing the International Air Transport Association's 2025 Annual Safety Report, the report says ground damage costs the industry more than $4.5 billion a year and could reach $9.7 billion within 15 years without further preventive measures. For WestJet, the eventual repair bill for its MAX 8 and the time out of service remain unknown.

facts.claim: A WestJet Boeing 737 MAX 8's winglet made contact with a parked catering truck while being towed to an overnight parking pad at Toronto Pearson, with no guests on board and no injuries reported.
Canada's Transportation Safety Board said the collision occurred at about 8:15 p.m. on Tuesday evening and that it was gathering information but did not plan to deploy investigators.
The aircraft, registered C-FRYV, arrived at Toronto two hours earlier operating as WS2221 from Puerto Vallarta.
The extent of the aircraft's damage and any subsequent operational disruption has not been officially confirmed.

IATA's 2025 Annual Safety Report, as cited in the report, puts annual ground-damage costs at more than $4.5 billion, potentially reaching $9.7 billion within 15 years without further preventive measures.
